description: Local configuration format naming the loops PEC serves and the closed, PEC-versioned feed profiles PEC reads each loop with. Schema version 1 is not accepted by the version-2 loader.

loops.description: The configured loops PEC may read as non-authoritative file-truth locations.

feed_profiles.description: The feed profiles PEC applies to this loop: PEC's reading hypothesis, never the loop's truth. At least one entry; a profile identifier appears at most once per loop.

basis.description: Citation to the loop's own record that supports this declaration. Normalized repository-relative path (no leading '/', no '..' segment, no backslash).

profile.description: Identifier from PEC's closed feed-profile vocabulary. Path conventions and grammars for each profile live in PEC's adapters.

oneOf.description: JSON run evidence under execution/_Coordination/AgentRuns/ (WORK_GRAPH.json, STATUS.json, RUNTIME_SUMMARY.json).
The loop's loop/LOOP_RECEIPTS.md receipt ledger, under that loop's grammar.
Loops that select work from _STATUS.md '## Remaining' items: lifecycle with those items, the loop/LOOP_RECEIPTS.md ledger as the receipt feed, dependency registers and decision registers.

The shared development-loop method: undertaking work graphs (execution/_Coordination/WorkGraphs/<undertaking>/WORK_GRAPH.md), central receipts (execution/_Coordination/AgentRuns/<RunID>/RECEIPT.md), the deliverable MEMORY.md run index, _STATUS.md lifecycle, dependency registers and decision registers.

state.description: live: the loop currently writes this generation. historical: the generation is frozen, and its silence is never reported as staleness.

version.description: Version of the selected profile; every profile in this vocabulary is at version 1.

loop_id.description: Stable lower-case identifier for one configured loop.

loop_init_path.description: Repository-relative path to the loop's governed LOOP_INIT.md surface.

schema_version.description: Version of this local loop-registry configuration format.

title: PEC local loop registry configuration v2
